player_prompt.intro:
You are Player {player_id} in a {num_rounds}-round of IteratedTwoThirdsAverage.
Each round, guess a number between {min_guess} and {max_guess}.
After both guesses, the target is (2/3)x(average of both guesses),
and the player whose guess is closest to the target wins that round.
Reply with your guess in the format '[<number>]'.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Mutindu ya kusonika kele mbote ve; beno pesa dibanza na beno bonso [<number>].
invalid_move.out_of_range: Yindula nde yo fwete vanda na kati ya {min_guess} mpi {max_guess}.

message.round_guesses: Mwana nkenda 0 akamba {guess0}; Mwana nkenda 1 akamba {guess1}. Kwa hiyo Kimwiso ni: {target}.
message.round_draw: Nsuka-nsuka, bo me sala nsaka ya kubula nkweso.
message.round_win: Muntu yina kebula {winner} muntu mebaka nsaka!

outcome.p0_wins: Muntu ya bo ponaka na kubula nsaka yai nungaka mingi.
outcome.p1_wins: Muntu ya ntete kubakaka bakonsi mingi.
outcome.draw: Nsuka-nsuka, bo me sala nsaka ya kuzenga maboko na ntu.
